Priya R: Heads up — ran into an SDK failure when /v2/generate returned "results": null instead of an array. Do we have a clear contract for nullable vs empty collections? Quick canary would help. cc @Samir :eyes:
Samir: We discussed this last quarter — contract said collection fields are optional, but if present should be the right type (array). We never committed to allowing null. SDKs typically expect array or absence, not null. Returning null looks like a bug to me.
Alex M: +1. Practically some older clients treat null==missing, but modern JS SDKs blow up when they get null and call .map/.length. Two options: 1) normalize on server -> map null to [] (fast), 2) tighten contract and reject null (safer long term).
Irene (eng-runtime): Runtime can implement a sanitize layer that maps null->[] for specific known endpoints/fields. We already do similar for legacy responses in Dedicated. If we do that, put it behind a feature flag and canary in us-west1.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: feature/sanitize-null -> staging at 2799123465 by Alex M :rocket:
Priya R: Proposed plan: 1) Add JSON-schema lint in API gateway to fail if array fields are null. 2) For short-term canary, enable runtime sanitize mapping null->[] behind a flag. 3) Notify SDK owners to tolerate null during rollout. Samir, can you own SDK patch? :question:
Samir: Yep — I'll patch SDKs so parsing accepts null and treats it like [] and add unit tests. Will open PRs today, ETA EOD. Also adding a test that deserializing "results": null -> yields [] in client.
Alex M: For the canary, here's a curl you can use to simulate server returning null (paste into staging):
```
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v2/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prompt":"test","_debug_force_null_results":true}'
```
Then verify SDK behavior locally.
Priya R: Schema example we should lint against (API gateway):
```
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "results": { "type": "array", "items": {"type":"object"} }
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```
Meaning: if present, results MUST be array (no null).
Irene (eng-runtime): Rollout plan for sanitize flag: 1% -> 10% -> 100% in us-west1 over 6h with metrics: 4xx/5xx, sdk-parse-errors, median latency. I’ll wire an automated rollback if parse-errors spike > 5x baseline.
Samir: I'll monitor SDK CI and add telemetry to catch parse exceptions fast. If you flip the flag ping #eng-oncall and I’ll watch.
Alex M: Sounds good. One more note: update the client docs and changelog so partners know we tightened behavior.
Priya R: OK — owners: runtime sanitize canary = Irene; API gateway lint = Alex; SDK patches = Samir. I'll create a short RFC in /docs but launching the canary first. :thumbsup:
Irene (eng-runtime): Starting canary deploy to staging in ~10m. Will post link to rollout dashboard.
Samir: PRs opened: client-js#482, client-py#215. Linking in thread when ready.
Priya R: Thanks everyone — let's reconvene in #eng-platform after the canary for a quick post-check. :eyes:
